description: Test 8 (corrected for RS1 and RS7). The reset percentages are the shipped 80 x 0.01f = 0x3F4CCCCC (0.79999995). A steady (200, 0, 0) tract at age 70 > 65: age -> 40, EQ 50 x 0x3F4CCCCC = 39.999996 (0x421FFFFF), HQ 60 x 0x3F4CCCCC = 47.999996 (0x423FFFFF), one float32 rounding each. The histogram (step 11) uses the post-reset age 40 (bucket (40 - 20) / 3 = 6) and trunc(EQ) = 39: ageCount[6] = 200, ageEqSum[6] = 39 x 200 = 7800. LE 61 needs HQ 44 (60 + 4 x 0.25, exact).
